title: Normalization Protocol for Custom Labware
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare input CSV file
steps.instruction:
Create a .csv file that lists the biomass of each sample. Include a header row with column numbers (1‑8) and a first column with row letters (A‑F). For wells that should be ignored, enter a value of 0. Use the following format (example values shown):

```
,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8
A,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0
B,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0
C,80,60.72,82.79,207.23,370.24,265.78,270.34,342.88
D,70,56.65,99.74,249.64,340.56,285.08,294,366.09
E,117.17,162.28,88.7,135.69,322.46,321,285.73,375.51
F,130.01,172.35,93.48,136.36,326.26,285.79,316.29,344.37
```
You may download a template from the provided link and edit it with your own values.

substeps.instruction: Open a spreadsheet program and create a new file.
Enter the header row (blank cell, then 1‑8).
Enter row labels (A‑F) in the first column.
Fill each cell with the corresponding biomass value; use 0 for wells to ignore.
Save the file with a .csv extension.
Optionally download and modify the template CSV from the link.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: Add your custom labware definition files (.json) to the Opentrons App.

substeps.instruction: Open the OT App and click **More**.
Select **Custom Labware** > **Add Labware**.
Browse to the folder containing your .json labware files and select them.
Confirm that the labware appears in the Custom Labware list.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: Load the Python protocol script (.py) into the OT App.

substeps.instruction: In the OT App, go to the **Protocol** tab.
Click **Upload** (or drag‑and‑drop) and choose your .py file.
Verify that the protocol appears in the list of available protocols.

steps.title: Set up deck as per map
steps.instruction: Arrange the physical deck to match the protocol’s deck map, using the specified labware.

substeps.instruction: Place three 1.5 mL tuberacks on the deck positions indicated in the map.
Load tip racks compatible with the P300 and P1000 single‑channel pipettes onto their designated slots.
Add any additional labware (e.g., reservoirs) required by the protocol.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Perform calibration of all labware, tip racks, and pipettes using the OT App.

substeps.instruction: Select **Calibrate** in the OT App.
Follow the on‑screen prompts to calibrate each tip rack.
Calibrate the P300 single‑channel pipette.
Calibrate the P1000 single‑channel pipette.
Confirm that all calibrations are successful before running the protocol.
